newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields rise on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields rose on Wednesday at the daily auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.49 and 3.82 percent, respectively, up from 0.46 and 3.77 percent on Tuesday and from 0.41 and 3.71 percent at Monday's auctions.

Bids were received for a total of 39.860 billion lev worth of T-bills as the two issues were oversubscribed but the ministry accepted bids only up to the limit of its total offer of 36 billion levs worth.
The issues were offered with par values of eight billion levs and 28 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 8,000 million levs 28,000 million levs
Bids received 8,615 million levs 31,245.1 million levs
Avg price of bids 99.51 pct 96.32 pct
Bids approved 8,000 million levs 28,000 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 0.49 pct 3.82 pct
